@startuml
actor Member
actor Librarian
actor Administrator
actor Guest
participant HomePage
participant LoginPage
participant LoginController
participant UserDetailsPage
participant BookCatalog
participant BookDetailsPage
participant ReservationController
participant IssueController
participant ReturnController
participant MemberDatabase
participant BookDatabase
participant CategoryBrowser
== Member Login and View Details ==
Member -> HomePage: Click "Login" button
activate HomePage
HomePage -> LoginPage: Display login page
deactivate HomePage
activate LoginPage
Member -> LoginPage: Enter login ID and password
Member -> LoginPage: Click "Confirm"
LoginPage -> LoginController: Validate credentials
activate LoginController
LoginController -> MemberDatabase: Check member credentials
MemberDatabase --> LoginController: Credentials valid/invalid
alt Invalid credentials
LoginController -> LoginPage: Prompt re-enter details
else Valid credentials
LoginController -> LoginPage: Login successful
LoginPage -> Member: Show member dashboard
end
deactivate LoginController
Member -> UserDetailsPage: Click "View User Details"
activate UserDetailsPage
UserDetailsPage -> MemberDatabase: Retrieve member details
MemberDatabase --> UserDetailsPage: Member details (issued books, dates, fines)
UserDetailsPage -> Member: Display member details
Member -> UserDetailsPage: Close details page
UserDetailsPage -> Member: Show "OK" message
deactivate UserDetailsPage
== Browse and Reserve Book ==
Member -> CategoryBrowser: Browse book categories
activate CategoryBrowser
CategoryBrowser -> BookCatalog: Show categories
Member -> CategoryBrowser: Select category
CategoryBrowser -> BookCatalog: Retrieve books in category
BookCatalog --> CategoryBrowser: List of books
CategoryBrowser -> Member: Display books
deactivate CategoryBrowser
Member -> BookDetailsPage: Select book to view details
activate BookDetailsPage
BookDetailsPage -> BookDatabase: Get book details
BookDatabase --> BookDetailsPage: Book details
BookDetailsPage -> Member: Show book details
deactivate BookDetailsPage
Member -> ReservationController: Reserve book (enter book ID)
activate ReservationController
ReservationController -> BookDatabase: Check book availability
BookDatabase --> ReservationController: Available/Reserved
alt Book already reserved
ReservationController -> Member: Ask to select another book
else Book available
ReservationController -> BookDatabase: Reserve book for member
BookDatabase --> ReservationController: Reservation confirmed
ReservationController -> Member: Reservation successful
end
deactivate ReservationController
== Issue Book ==
Member -> Librarian: Request to issue book (provide member ID)
Librarian -> IssueController: Check book availability
activate IssueController
IssueController -> BookDatabase: Check book status
IssueController -> MemberDatabase: Check books issued to member
alt Member has 3 books issued
IssueController -> Librarian: Cannot issue more books
else Eligible
IssueController -> BookDatabase: Issue book to member
BookDatabase --> IssueController: Book issued
IssueController -> Librarian: Book issued
end
deactivate IssueController
== Return Book ==
Member -> Librarian: Return book (provide book ID, member ID)
Librarian -> ReturnController: Process book return
activate ReturnController
ReturnController -> BookDatabase: Validate book ID
alt Invalid book ID
ReturnController -> Librarian: Prompt to re-enter book ID
else Valid book ID
ReturnController -> BookDatabase: Mark book as returned
BookDatabase --> ReturnController: Book return confirmed
ReturnController -> Librarian: Show success message
end
deactivate ReturnController
== Add/Remove Book (Librarian) ==
Librarian -> BookCatalog: Add or remove book option
activate BookCatalog
alt Add book
BookCatalog -> Librarian: Prompt for book details
Librarian -> BookCatalog: Enter book details
BookCatalog -> BookDatabase: Add book
BookDatabase --> BookCatalog: Book added
else Remove book
BookCatalog -> Librarian: Select book to remove
Librarian -> BookCatalog: Confirm removal
BookCatalog -> BookDatabase: Remove book
BookDatabase --> BookCatalog: Book removed
end
deactivate BookCatalog
== Add/Remove Member (Administrator) ==
Administrator -> MemberDatabase: Add or remove member option
activate MemberDatabase
alt Add member
MemberDatabase -> Administrator: Prompt for member details
Administrator -> MemberDatabase: Enter member details
MemberDatabase -> MemberDatabase: Add member
MemberDatabase --> Administrator: Member added
else Remove member
MemberDatabase -> Administrator: Select member to remove
Administrator -> MemberDatabase: Provide removal reason
MemberDatabase -> MemberDatabase: Remove member
MemberDatabase --> Administrator: Member removed
end
deactivate MemberDatabase
@enduml
